items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was really surprised about the Staple Singers because I've known Roosevelt Staples. [INTERVIEWEE] Pop Staples?

ctx.x: Yeah, I know the Staple Singers -- Staple Singers, right, but, see, during the last ten, 12, 15 years, most all of these people -- see, the money was over here, and so they just switched over, like the Staple Singers, Aretha Franklin.
I was really surprised about the Staple Singers because I've known Roosevelt Staples.
